title: Red Sand Multiplying
description: Craft extra Red Sand by adding some regular sand to it. Craft regular sand from different sand variants. Recycle needless concrete blocks and powders to dye them again.
body:
# **About:**
Simple and small, **Vanilla-friendly** mod that adds a way to craft more **Red Sand** if you already obtained some of it. It also provides a way to recycle needless **Concrete**. Do you ever had some concrete powder left, because you were forced to craft 8? Never again!

## **Modpacks?**
Feel free to use in your!

## **Mod Compatibility**
Should work with most mods, but without any special interactions. For now... 

###  **Create**
Addon in the works! Will support more balanced and funnier ways of crafting **Sand Variants**.
### **Terrain Generation Mods**
Want to multiply **Sand Variants** from **Mods**? Addon is in the works!

**Planned to support:**
- Biomes O' Plenty
- Oh The Biomes We've Gone
